---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new capability, MCP tool, provider integration, or safety policy
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or Use Case
Describe the workflow or problem you are trying to solve while away from your desk.
*(e.g., "When my agent runs long test suites, I want a way to...")*

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of how you envision the feature working, including any new `.env` options, WhatsApp reply commands, or MCP tool parameters.

## Fail-Closed & Security Considerations
Does this feature affect how actions are approved, rejected, or escalated?
- How should it behave on timeout or error?
- Does it involve any sensitive data that should pass through `redactSecrets()`?

## Alternatives Considered
Any workarounds or alternative designs you have considered.
